side.alt: Close view of a roaring lion’s profile formed from glazed bricks, its white and yellow face emerging against blue-green blocks, the surface showing cracks, uneven edges, and worn textured glaze.

threequarter.alt: Angled view of a glazed, weathered brick wall depicting a striding lion in cream tones against a blue-green background, the top and bottom lined with a border of terracotta bricks.

views.back: none: it hangs on a wall
